usedFor: buttondown holds subscribers and emails, and Google Drive shares a file after “Creating a Subscriber” through “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “Creating a Subscriber” in buttondown, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new subscriber triggers a shareable link to a file you choose, set to Viewer, Commenter or Editor.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file to everyone with the link, so check the access level first.
